claims: The 98th Academy Awards were held in 2026.
Ryan Coogler's Sinners won four Oscars at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler's Sinners received 16 nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler's Sinners' 16 nominations were record-setting.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for his role as twins Smoke and Stack.
Ryan Coogler won Best Original Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler was a first-time Oscar winner.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw won Best Cinematography at the 98th Academy Awards.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw became the first woman to win Best Cinematography.
Ludwig Göransson won Best Original Score at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ludwig Göransson's Best Original Score win was his third Oscar win
